headline: Sensex jumps over 500 points, Nifty ends near 25,300 supported by FII inflows and FMCG stocks

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Foreign fund inflows and FII buying provided strong support to the Indian market rally.
Market gains were broadly led by FMCG and banking sector stocks.
BSE Insurance Index registered gains, climbing 1.15%.
Early trade momentum was fueled by gains in heavyweights like ITC, Airtel, and Asian Paints.
whatHappening: Sensex surged over 500 points while Nifty50 closed at 25,291.
Max Healthcare emerged as the top gainer in today's market session.
Sebi constituted a sub-group under PMAC to review key IPO norms, chaired by NSE's Chauhan.
Economists recommended retaining capital gains tax on equities to FM Sitharaman ahead of Budget 2027-28.
summary:
Indian benchmark indices surged as Sensex jumped over 500 points and Nifty closed near 25,300.
The rally was supported by foreign fund inflows along with strong buying in FMCG and banking stocks.
Max Healthcare was among the top gainers, while SEBI set up a sub-group to review IPO norms.
